recovery.hold.next: Next: look at the Run (deckent run inspect), then resume or close it.
recovery.hold.system: The safety system held this Run for a reason this version does not know; a person checks it.
recovery.hold.recovery.effects-open: A lost worker left outside work whose result is not known; a person checks it before anything continues.
recovery.hold.recovery.settled-not-idemp: A lost worker finished outside work that cannot safely be done twice; a person decides how to continue.
recovery.hold.recovery.settled-over-boun: A lost worker finished more outside work than a new attempt may be told about; a person decides.
recovery.hold.recovery.continuation-boun: This task was already continued once after a lost worker; another loss goes to a person.
recovery.hold.recovery.attempt-ceiling: This task reached its attempt limit; no further automatic attempt opens.
recovery.hold.recovery.run-bound: This Run reached its limit of automatic recoveries; a person decides.
recovery.hold.recovery.same-evidence: The worker was lost again for the same reason; repeating would not help, so a person decides.
recovery.hold.recovery.run-closed: The Run was closing while a lost worker was handled; nothing continues.
recovery.hold.recovery.human-chosen: The recovery decision handed this lost worker's task to a person.
recovery.hold.recovery.continuation-not-: Automatic continuation after a lost worker is not approved here (no standing grant); a person decides.
recovery.hold.recovery.no-eligible-model: No active model may make recovery decisions here; a person decides.
recovery.hold.recovery.consent-required: The recovery model's subscription has no consent for system use; a person decides.
recovery.hold.recovery.model-failed: The recovery decision model could not answer; it is not asked again and a person decides.
recovery.hold.recovery.answer-invalid: The recovery decision model's answer could not be used; it is not asked again and a person decides.
recovery.hold.recovery.breaker-open: Too many lost workers in a short time, so recovery decisions are paused; a person decides.
recovery.hold.recovery.work-class-not-lo: This task's work class is not low-risk, so a lost worker's task does not continue on its own; a person decides.
recovery.hold.recovery.isolation-unprove: This lost worker's dispatch record does not prove it had no route to a customer system, so its task does not continue on its own; a person decides.
recovery.hold.nervous.not-lost: The safety system held this Run: the worker was not proven lost; a person checks it.
recovery.hold.nervous.not-granted: The safety system held this Run: the lost worker was never granted its start; a person checks it.
recovery.hold.nervous.fence-required: The safety system held this Run: the lost worker's late writes could not be blocked yet; a person checks it.
recovery.hold.nervous.fence-mismatch: The safety system held this Run: the block on late writes belongs to another worker; a person checks it.
recovery.hold.nervous.termination-requir: The safety system held this Run: there is no proof the lost worker stopped, so its slot stays taken; a person checks it.
recovery.hold.nervous.termination-mismat: The safety system held this Run: the stop proof belongs to another worker; a person checks it.
recovery.hold.nervous.hold-run: The safety system held this Run; a person checks it.
recovery.hold.nervous.hand-to-human: The safety system handed this Run to a person.
recovery.state.line: Lost-worker recovery: safety system {nervous} · recovery {recovery} · standing grant {grant}
recovery.state.none: Lost workers are not recovered automatically; their Runs wait for a person.
recovery.state.recorded: Recovery decisions are only recorded; nothing changes.
recovery.state.automatic: A lost worker's task may continue in a new attempt within its limits.
recovery.state.person: Without the standing grant every lost-worker case goes to a person.
recovery.state.partial: Scopes without the standing grant send every lost-worker case to a person.
recovery.state.unknown: The standing grant could not be read; lost-worker cases go to a person until it can.
recovery.unresolved.off: Automatic recovery was off when this Run was admitted: nothing is retried and no new attempt starts on its own; a person decides.
recovery.unresolved.shadow: Recovery runs in shadow mode for this Run: a recovery decision is recorded for review, but nothing continues on its own; a person decides.
recovery.unresolved.live: Automatic recovery is on for this Run: once the worker is proven lost, no outside work is left open and the owner's standing grant allows it, Deckent may continue this task with a new attempt within the limits frozen for this Run; otherwise a person decides.
error.RECOVERY_TARGET_INVALID: Nothing changed: that recovery action, rule or case is not one this card offers here. Run deckent policy recovery or deckent recovery review to see what you can choose.
error.RECOVERY_ROLLOUT_CRITERIA_UNMET: Not changed: {target} can be turned on in scope {scope} only after its measured exit criteria ({criteria}) are met.
recovery.next.RECOVERY_ROLLOUT_CRITERIA_: Run deckent recovery --scope {scope} to see each number and what moves it.
error.RECOVERY_CELL_NOT_OWN: Not changed: {target} in scope {scope} can be turned on here only when your own approval rule for exactly it, naming only you, is the one rule that decides it; here a role, a broader or a shared rule decides it. Whoever administers this installation's policy decides it there.
error.RECOVERY_ACTION_NO_EXECUTOR: Not changed: {action} has no effect in this release, so no standing grant is written for it.
error.RECOVERY_VERDICT_CONFLICT: Not changed: case {case} already has a different answer from you; one answer per case is kept.
recovery.rollout.summary: Rollout: rules ready {met}/{rules} · agreement {agreements}/{decided} · {waiting} waiting for your choice.
recovery.rollout.incomplete: (the newest records reached the reading limit, so no criterion counts as met)
recovery.rollout.decisions: Decisions: {agreements} of {decided} reviewed cases agreed with you ({perMille}‰); {waiting} waiting for your choice; exit criteria {met}.
recovery.rollout.note.counterfactual: In shadow, a case whose stop was not applied is decided as if the stop had been applied; agreement is measured on that input.
recovery.rollout.note.evidence: Meeting the exit criteria is evidence only: promoting a rule and granting an action stay your decision (deckent policy recovery).
recovery.review.none: No case waits for your choice.
recovery.review.title: Case {case}: was the worker really lost?
recovery.review.wouldStop: Decided as if the stop had been applied (in shadow nothing was stopped).
recovery.review.choice.continue: Lost: continue in a new attempt
recovery.review.verdict.notLost: You marked it a false alarm.
